platformAffiliatesPage.title: Affiliate marketing
platformAffiliatesPage.hint: Add a referrer (a sale, a salon owner, or a customer) to promote the salon-owner signup program. Once a salon they referred is approved and has a complete profile (address, opening hours, services), the referrer earns a commission % on every one of that salon's bookings going forward. VaraaAi only tracks and tallies commissions — you pay them yourself, outside the system.
